units: <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:26:1">Koh. R. to VII, 26</cite> [read:] <he>בההוא ליליא נפק ל׳ ותקף וכ׳</he> that night the robber (with his band) marched out, but the guard was close behind them.
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 3:14">Esth. R. to I, 12</cite> <he>הן דל׳ וכ׳</he> (not <he>דליסטאות</he>), v. <cite ref="E00650"><he>הָן</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 30:6">Lev. R. s. 30</cite> <he>איתציד ההוא ליסטא</he>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 651:7">Yalk. ib. 651</cite> <he>איתסב ההוא ל׳ וכ׳</he> that robber was captured.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 106b:2">Snh. 106ᵇ</cite> (in a gentile record concerning Balaam) <he>כד … פנחס ל׳</he> when Phineas, the robber, slew him; a. e.—Pl. <he>לִיסְטַיָּא</he>, <cite ref="L00586"><he>לִיסְטִין</he></cite>, <he>לִיסְטָאֵי</he>, <cite ref="L00497"><he>לִסְ׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 4:11">Targ. Job IV, 11</cite> (Ms. … <he>טֵסַיָּא</he>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Judges 5:11">Targ. Jud. V, 11</cite>.—Pesik. Shub., p. 165ᵇ (synon. with <he>גַּיְיסוֹת</he>).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 60">Gen. R. s. 60</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 5:1:7">Y. Shek. V, 48ᵈ</cite> top; a. fr.
